The database path is read from settings on every call.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    class_year    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    conference TEXT NOT NULL,\n    city       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,\n    end_date   TEXT NOT NULL,\n    summary    TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recap (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    trip_id           INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trip (id),\n    owner_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title             TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_name       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_class_year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                      CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    published_at      TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS image (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    recap_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recap (id),\n    filename     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    content_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n    size         INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    alt          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_state (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),\n    last_rendered_at  TEXT\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open a connection; commit on success, roll back on error, always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    except BaseException:\n        conn.rollback()\n        raise\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _add_column_if_missing(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str,\n                           definition: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never alters a table that already exists, so\n    a column added to SCHEMA later is added here for databases made before it.\"\"\"\n    existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    if column not in existing:\n        try:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:\n            # Another process started at the same moment and added it first.\n            if \"duplicate column name\" not in str(exc):\n                raise\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_column_if_missing(conn, \"recap\", \"published_at\", \"TEXT\")\n=== app/policy.py\n\"\"\"The permission policy: can this Account do this action to this object?\n\nEvery route asks `can` (through `security.require`); routes never check roles\nthemselves. Unknown actions are denied. Add an action here when a ticket adds a\ncapability. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    return True\n=== app/security.py\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF and the route guard.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, itsdangerous\nunderneath) holding the Account id and a CSRF token. The Account itself is\nreread from the database on every request.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, policy\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\nLOGIN_URL = \"/login\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def csrf_protect(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: refuse any state-changing request without the token.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"Missing or invalid CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Reread the signed-in Account; a Deactivated one counts as signed out.\"\"\"\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = accounts.get(account_id) if account_id else None\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n        return None\n    return account\n\n\ndef require(action: str) -> Callable[..., Account]:\n    \"\"\"Route dependency: logged out -> login page, not allowed -> 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def guard(account: Account | None = Depends(current_account)) -> Account:\n        if account is None:\n            raise HTTPException(303, headers={\"Location\": LOGIN_URL})\n        if not policy.can(account, action):\n            raise HTTPException(403, \"You do not have permission to do that\")\n        return account\n\n    return guard\n=== app/slugs.py\n\"\"\"Suggested Slugs. A suggestion is only a starting point; the Admin or Editor\ncan edit it, and uniqueness is checked when the form is saved.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport unicodedata\n\nfrom app.trips import parse_date\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"URL-safe form of text: lowercase ASCII letters and digits, joined by\n    single hyphens.\"\"\"\n    ascii_text = (unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                  .encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode())\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef is_url_safe(slug: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True if slug is what slugify could produce: lowercase ASCII letters and\n    digits joined by single hyphens.\"\"\"\n    return re.fullmatch(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\", slug) is not None\n\n\ndef suggest_trip_slug(start_date: str, city: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Start year plus city, such as 2026-chicago; empty until the start date is\n    a real date and the city is known.\"\"\"\n    start, city_slug = parse_date(start_date.strip()), slugify(city)\n    return f\"{start.year}-{city_slug}\" if start and city_slug else \"\"\n=== app/site_state.py\n\"\"\"Site state: the single record of when `cms publish` last rendered the Public\nsite. T08's \"changes not yet live\" notice compares content edit times against it.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_NOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\"\n\n\ndef record_render() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Stamp now as the time the Public site was last rendered.\"\"\"\n    db.init_db()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            f\"INSERT INTO site_state (id, last_rendered_at) VALUES (1, {_NOW}) \"\n            f\"ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET last_rendered_at = {_NOW}\")\n\n\ndef last_rendered() -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"When the Public site was last rendered, or None if it never has.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT last_rendered_at FROM site_state WHERE id = 1\").fetchone()\n    return row[\"last_rendered_at\"] if row else None\n=== app/flash.py\n\"\"\"One-shot notices carried to the next page in the signed session cookie.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nKEY = \"flashes\"\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue `message` to show on the next page this session renders.\"\"\"\n    request.session[KEY] = [*request.session.get(KEY, []), message]\n\n\ndef take_flashes(request: Request) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The queued notices, removed so each shows once.\"\"\"\n    return request.session.pop(KEY, [])\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin, with /login and /logout beside it; the\npublic site answers at /. Add routes in their own modules under app/routes/ and\ninclude them here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, recaps, trips\nfrom app.security import csrf_protect\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\nlog = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_DEV_DEFAULT:\n        log.warning(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY is not set: sessions are signed with the \"\n                    \"public development key. Development use only.\")\n    db.init_db()\n    # csrf_protect runs on every route, so no state-changing route can skip it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", dependencies=[Depends(csrf_protect)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"lax\",\n                       https_only=False)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(trips.router)\n    app.include_router(recaps.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"items\": [], \"css_path\": \"style.css\", \"home_path\": \"index.html\",\n             \"instagram_url\": settings.INSTAGRAM_URL},\n        )\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/templating.py\n\"\"\"The shared Jinja environment for the console.\"\"\"\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.flash import take_flashes\nfrom app.security import csrf_token\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token  # {{ csrf_token(request) }}\ntemplates.env.globals[\"take_flashes\"] = take_flashes  # {{ take_flashes(request) }}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"849240d3-cef1-4a35-a8b7-9d11ee1d3b0c","timestamp":"2026-10-24T17:03:51.359Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"=== app/db.py\n\"\"\"SQLite access. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    return True\n=== app/security.py\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF and the route guard.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, itsdangerous\nunderneath) holding the Account id and a CSRF token. The Account itself is\nreread from the database on every request.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, policy\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\nLOGIN_URL = \"/login\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def csrf_protect(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: refuse any state-changing request without the token.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"Missing or invalid CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Reread the signed-in Account; a Deactivated one counts as signed out.\"\"\"\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = accounts.get(account_id) if account_id else None\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n        return None\n    return account\n\n\ndef require(action: str) -> Callable[..., Account]:\n    \"\"\"Route dependency: logged out -> login page, not allowed -> 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def guard(account: Account | None = Depends(current_account)) -> Account:\n        if account is None:\n            raise HTTPException(303, headers={\"Location\": LOGIN_URL})\n        if not policy.can(account, action):\n            raise HTTPException(403, \"You do not have permission to do that\")\n        return account\n\n    return guard\n=== app/slugs.py\n\"\"\"Suggested Slugs. A suggestion is only a starting point; the Admin or Editor\ncan edit it, and uniqueness is checked when the form is saved.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport unicodedata\n\nfrom app.trips import parse_date\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"URL-safe form of text: lowercase ASCII letters and digits, joined by\n    single hyphens.\"\"\"\n    ascii_text = (unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                  .encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode())\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef is_url_safe(slug: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True if slug is what slugify could produce: lowercase ASCII letters and\n    digits joined by single hyphens.\"\"\"\n    return re.fullmatch(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\", slug) is not None\n\n\ndef suggest_trip_slug(start_date: str, city: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Start year plus city, such as 2026-chicago; empty until the start date is\n    a real date and the city is known.\"\"\"\n    start, city_slug = parse_date(start_date.strip()), slugify(city)\n    return f\"{start.year}-{city_slug}\" if start and city_slug else \"\"\n=== app/site_state.py\n\"\"\"Site state: the single record of when `cms publish` last rendered the Public\nsite. T08's \"changes not yet live\" notice compares content edit times against it.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_NOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\"\n\n\ndef record_render() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Stamp now as the time the Public site was last rendered.\"\"\"\n    db.init_db()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            f\"INSERT INTO site_state (id, last_rendered_at) VALUES (1, {_NOW}) \"\n            f\"ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET last_rendered_at = {_NOW}\")\n\n\ndef last_rendered() -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"When the Public site was last rendered, or None if it never has.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT last_rendered_at FROM site_state WHERE id = 1\").fetchone()\n    return row[\"last_rendered_at\"] if row else None\n=== app/flash.py\n\"\"\"One-shot notices carried to the next page in the signed session cookie.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nKEY = \"flashes\"\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue `message` to show on the next page this session renders.\"\"\"\n    request.session[KEY] = [*request.session.get(KEY, []), message]\n\n\ndef take_flashes(request: Request) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The queued notices, removed so each shows once.\"\"\"\n    return request.session.pop(KEY, [])\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin, with /login and /logout beside it; the\npublic site answers at /. Add routes in their own modules under app/routes/ and\ninclude them here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, recaps, trips\nfrom app.security import csrf_protect\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\nlog = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_DEV_DEFAULT:\n        log.warning(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY is not set: sessions are signed with the \"\n                    \"public development key. Development use only.\")\n    db.init_db()\n    # csrf_protect runs on every route, so no state-changing route can skip it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", dependencies=[Depends(csrf_protect)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"lax\",\n                       https_only=False)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(trips.router)\n    app.include_router(recaps.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"items\": [], \"css_path\": \"style.css\", \"home_path\": \"index.html\",\n             \"instagram_url\": settings.INSTAGRAM_URL},\n        )\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/templating.py\n\"\"\"The shared Jinja environment for the console.\"\"\"\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.flash import take_flashes\nfrom app.security import csrf_token\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token  # {{ csrf_token(request) }}\ntemplates.env.globals[\"take_flashes\"] = take_flashes  # {{ take_flashes(request) }}","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"classifierBoundary":true,"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"e855f0f1-9acd-4082-81bc-1575ea5be1a2","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":null,"status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":14},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"andrew-vera26/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"andrew-vera26/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"andrew-vera26/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sandboxed":false,"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"db034ac2-5082-4a50-93dd-c35a2ed013f9","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"classifier"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"325671b6-12f1-4195-8a3a-399467ce1920","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

The only place a Body is turned into HTML.\n\nPreview and `cms publish` both call `render_body`, so what the editor shows is\nwhat readers get. markdown-it-py renders first, then nh3 enforces an allowlist.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom typing import Collection\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\n\nALLOWED_TAGS = {\"a\", \"blockquote\", \"br\", \"code\", \"em\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\",\n                \"h5\", \"h6\", \"hr\", \"img\", \"li\", \"ol\", \"p\", \"pre\", \"strong\", \"ul\"}\nALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}}\n\n# markdown-it must parse raw HTML as HTML to tell it from text (with html=False\n# it becomes escaped text instead). It is parsed only to be thrown away: every\n# raw-HTML token is dropped before rendering, so none is ever rendered and none\n# leaves text behind. nh3 below is the second layer, enforcing the allowlist on\n# whatever markdown-it produced.\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True})\n\n_RAW_CONTENT_TAG = re.compile(r\"<(/?)(script|style)\\b\", re.I)\n_SCHEME = re.compile(r\"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\\-]*:\")\n# nh3 leaves a bare <a> where it dropped the href, and an <img> with no src.\n_BARE_LINK = re.compile(r\"<a>(.*?)</a>\", re.S)\n_SRCLESS_IMG = re.compile(r\"<img(?![^>]*\\bsrc=)[^>]*>\")\n\n\ndef is_relative(target: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a path like ``../other/`` or ``images/a.jpg``. Anything with a\n    scheme (http:, mailto:, javascript:), a host (//x) or a root (/x) is not.\"\"\"\n    target = re.sub(r\"[\\x00-\\x20]\", \"\", target).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n    return bool(target) and not _SCHEME.match(target) \\\n        and not target.startswith(\"/\")\n\n\ndef _drop_inline_html(children: list[Token]) -> list[Token]:\n    \"\"\"`children` without raw inline tags, and without anything between an\n    opening and closing <script> or <style> (their text is code, not prose).\"\"\"\n    kept, inside = [], None\n    for child in children:\n        if child.type == \"html_inline\":\n            found = _RAW_CONTENT_TAG.match(child.content)\n            if inside and found and found.group(1) and found.group(2).lower() == inside:\n                inside = None\n            elif not inside and found and not found.group(1):\n                inside = found.group(2).lower()\n        elif not inside:\n            kept.append(child)\n    return kept\n\n\ndef _render_without_raw_html(body: str) -> str:\n    tokens = [t for t in _markdown.parse(body) if t.type != \"html_block\"]\n    for token in tokens:\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and token.children:\n            token.children = _drop_inline_html(token.children)\n    return _markdown.renderer.render(tokens, _markdown.options, {})\n\n\ndef render_body(body: str, image_urls: Collection[str] = ()) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The sanitized HTML for a Markdown Body.\n\n    Links survive only if relative. Images survive only if their source is one\n    of `image_urls` (the Recap's own uploaded Images, as `images/<file>`). A removed\n    link keeps its text; a removed image leaves nothing. Raw HTML in the Body is\n    removed whole: a raw block disappears, a raw inline tag disappears and the\n    Markdown text around it stays.\n    \"\"\"\n    own = set(image_urls)\n\n    def keep(tag: str, attr: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n        if tag == \"a\" and attr == \"href\":\n            return value if is_relative(value) else None\n        if tag == \"img\" and attr == \"src\":\n            return value if value in own else None\n        return value\n\n    html = nh3.clean(_render_without_raw_html(body), tags=ALLOWED_TAGS,\n                     attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, url_schemes=set(),\n                     link_rel=None, attribute_filter=keep)\n    return _SRCLESS_IMG.sub(\"\", _BARE_LINK.sub(r\"\\1\", html))\n\n\n_IMG_TAG = re.compile(r\"<img\\b[^>]*>\")\n_ALT = re.compile(r'\\balt=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef images_without_alt(body: str, image_urls: Collection[str] = ()) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many of the Body's kept images have blank alt text. Counted on the\n    output of `render_body`, so only images that would be shown count.\"\"\"\n    return sum(1 for tag in _IMG_TAG.findall(render_body(body, image_urls))\n               if not (m := _ALT.search(tag)) or not m.group(1).strip())\n=== app/publish.py\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, images, settings\nfrom app.markdown import images_without_alt, render_body\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\nclass PublishRefused(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The Public site cannot be rendered; the message says which Recap and why.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _published_recaps() -> dict[int, list]:\n    \"\"\"Published Recaps by trip id, each list in the order they were Published.\n    The only place `cms publish` reads Recaps: nothing else is ever selected.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM recap WHERE status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY published_at, id\").fetchall()\n    by_trip: dict[int, list] = {}\n    for row in rows:\n        by_trip.setdefault(row[\"trip_id\"], []).append(row)\n    return by_trip\n\n\ndef _check_publishable(published: dict[int, list]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse, naming the Recap, before `site/` is touched: an Image with no alt\n    text in a Published Body (it can be edited after Publish), or an Image whose\n    uploaded file is gone. Raises PublishRefused.\"\"\"\n    for recaps in published.values():\n        for recap in recaps:\n            recap_images = images.list_images(recap[\"id\"])\n            if images_without_alt(recap[\"body\"], {\n                    f\"images/{i['filename']}\" for i in recap_images}):\n                raise PublishRefused(\n                    f\"Recap '{recap['slug']}' ({recap['title']}) has an image \"\n                    \"without alt text. Add alt text, then publish again.\")\n            for image in recap_images:\n                if not (settings.UPLOADS / image[\"filename\"]).is_file():\n                    raise PublishRefused(\n                        f\"Recap '{recap['slug']}' ({recap['title']}) uses the \"\n                        f\"image {image['filename']}, whose file is missing \"\n                        f\"from {settings.UPLOADS}.\")\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, path: Path, template: str, depth: int,\n           **context) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render `template` to `path`, with every link back to the site root\n    computed from the page's `depth` below it.\"\"\"\n    root = \"../\" * depth\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(\n        site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n        home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", instagram_url=settings.INSTAGRAM_URL,\n        **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    published = _published_recaps()\n    _check_publishable(published)\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        trips = [t for t in conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM trip ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC\")\n            if t[\"id\"] in published]\n\n    _write(env, out / \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\", 0,\n           title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n           items=[{\"href\": f\"trips/{t['slug']}/\", \"title\": t[\"conference\"],\n                   \"dates\": f\"{t['city']}, {t['start_date']}\"} for t in trips])\n    for trip in trips:\n        trip_dir = out / \"trips\" / trip[\"slug\"]\n        _write(env, trip_dir / \"index.html\", \"public/trip.html\", 2,\n               title=trip[\"conference\"], trip=trip,\n               recaps=published[trip[\"id\"]])\n        for recap in published[trip[\"id\"]]:\n            page_dir = trip_dir / recap[\"slug\"]\n            recap_images = images.list_images(recap[\"id\"])\n            _write(env, page_dir / \"index.html\",\n                   \"public/recap.html\", 3, title=recap[\"title\"], trip=trip,\n                   recap=recap, body_html=render_body(\n                       recap[\"body\"], {f\"images/{i['filename']}\"\n                                       for i in recap_images}))\n            for image in recap_images:\n                (page_dir / \"images\").mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n                shutil.copy2(settings.UPLOADS / image[\"filename\"],\n                             page_dir / \"images\" / image[\"filename\"])\n    return out\n=== app/recaps.py\n\"\"\"Recaps: one member's account of one Trip, and the status machine that moves\nthem from Draft to Published.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db, images\n\n\nclass RecapLocked(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's write found the Recap no longer their own Draft.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Another Recap on this Trip already uses this Slug.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Appended to an Editor's write so the write itself checks what the policy\n# checked a moment earlier; the Recap may have been Submitted in <footer><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n\n=== test_t04 (head)\n\"\"\"T04: the Recap status machine, sanitized Markdown and Preview.\n\nSeam: the HTTP app, through TestClient. Routes under test:\n\n    POST /admin/recaps/{id}/submit | send-back | publish | unpublish\n    POST /admin/recaps/{id}/preview   (an existing Recap's editor)\n    POST /admin/recaps/preview        (the New Recap editor)\n\nPreview re-renders the editor with the sanitized Body inside <section id=\"preview\">.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import db, recaps\nfrom tests.test_t03 import (BODY, RECAPS, make_recap, make_trip, post,\n                            recap_form, recap_row, second_editor)\n\nLIVE_NOTICE = \"still live until you Deploy\"\nREFUSED = (400, 403, 409)\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef editors_recap(client_as, status=\"draft\"):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's Recap, moved to `status` through the real routes.\n    Returns (recap_id, trip_id).\"\"\"\n    trip_id = make_trip(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    recap_id = make_recap(client_as(\"editor\"), trip_id)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        assert post(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/submit\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    if status == \"published\":\n        assert post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"status\"] == status\n    return recap_id, trip_id\n\n\ndef action_forms(html):\n    \"\"\"{form action: form html} for every <form> on the page.\"\"\"\n    return {m.group(1): m.group(0) for m in re.finditer(\n        r'<form[^>]*action=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>.*?</form>', html, re.S)}\n\n\ndef preview_region(html):\n    match = re.search(r'<section id=\"preview\">(.*?)</section>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"page has no <section id=\\\"preview\\\">\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# ---- the status machine: allowed transitions ------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"actor,start,action,end\", [\n    (\"editor\", \"draft\", \"submit\", \"submitted\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"send-back\", \"draft\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"publish\", \"published\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"publish\", \"published\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"unpublish\", \"draft\"),\n])\ndef test_allowed_transitions_move_the_status(client_as, actor, start, action,\n                                              end):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    r = post(client_as(actor), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/{action}\")\n    assert r.status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"status\"] == end\n\n\n# ---- the status machine: transitions not in the table ---------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"actor,start,action\", [\n    (\"editor\", \"submitted\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"published\", \"submit\"),\n    # Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it; the table has no Admin row.\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"publish\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"unpublish\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"unpublish\"),\n])\ndef test_transitions_not_in_the_table_are_refused(client_as, actor, start,\n                                                  action):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    before = tuple(recap_row(recap_id))\n    r = post(client_as(actor), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/{action}\")\n    assert r.status_code in REFUSED\n    assert tuple(recap_row(recap_id)) == before\n\n\n# ---- who may do what ------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"start,action\", [\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\"),\n    (\"submitted\", \"publish\"),\n    (\"submitted\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"),\n])\ndef test_an_editor_cannot_publish_unpublish_or_send_back(client_as, start,\n                                                         action):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    before = tuple(recap_row(recap_id))\n    r = post(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/{action}\")\n    assert r.status_code in REFUSED\n    assert tuple(recap_row(recap_id)) == before\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_cannot_submit_another_persons_recap(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    trip_id = make_trip(admin)\n    admins_entry = make_recap(admin, trip_id)\n    editors = make_recap(client_as(\"editor\"), trip_id, title=\"Mine\", slug=\"mine\")\n\n    other = second_editor()\n    for recap_id in (admins_entry, editors):\n        before = tuple(recap_row(recap_id))\n        assert post(other, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/submit\").status_code == 403\n        assert tuple(recap_row(recap_id)) == before","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"e7de70ff-43a8-42e0-867f-24611299dd42","timestamp":"2026-10-24T17:03:59.758Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"=== (the New Recap editor)\n\nPreview re-renders the editor with the sanitized Body inside <section id=\"preview\">.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import db, recaps\nfrom tests.test_t03 post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"status\"] == status\n    return recap_id, trip_id\n\n\ndef action_forms(html):\n    \"\"\"{form action: form html} for every <form> on the page.\"\"\"\n    return {m.group(1): m.group(0) for m in re.finditer(\n        r'<form[^>]*action=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>.*?</form>', html, re.S)}\n\n\ndef preview_region(html):\n    match = re.search(r'<section id=\"preview\">(.*?)</section>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"page has no <section id=\\\"preview\\\">\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# ---- the status machine: allowed transitions \"draft\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"publish\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"unpublish\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", Images survive only if their source is one\n    of `image_urls` (the Recap's own uploaded Images, as `images/<file>`). A removed\n    link keeps its text; a removed image leaves nothing. Raw HTML in the Body is\n    removed whole: a raw block disappears, a raw inline tag disappears and the\n    Markdown text around it stays.\n    \"\"\"\n    own = set(image_urls)\n\n    def keep(tag: str, attr: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n        if tag == \"a\" and attr == \"href\":\n            return value if is_relative(value) else None\n        if tag == \"img\" and attr == \"src\":\n            return value if value in own else None\n        return value\n\n    html = nh3.clean(_render_without_raw_html(body), tags=ALLOWED_TAGS,\n                     attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, url_schemes=set(),\n                     link_rel=None, attribute_filter=keep)\n    return _SRCLESS_IMG.sub(\"\", _BARE_LINK.sub(r\"\\1\", html))\n\n\n_IMG_TAG = re.compile(r\"<img\\b[^>]*>\")\n_ALT = re.compile(r'\\balt=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef images_without_alt(body: str, image_urls: Collection[str] = ()) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many of the Body's kept images have blank alt text. Counted on the\n    output of `render_body`, so only images that would be shown count.\"\"\"\n    return sum(1 for tag in _IMG_TAG.findall(render_body(body, image_urls))\n               if not (m := _ALT.search(tag)) or not m.group(1).strip())\n=== publish\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, images, settings\nfrom app.markdown import images_without_alt, render_body\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\nclass PublishRefused(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The Public site cannot be rendered; the message says which Recap and why.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _published_recaps() -> dict[int, list]:\n    \"\"\"Published Recaps by trip id, each list in the order they were Published.\n    The only place `cms publish` reads Recaps: nothing else is ever selected.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM recap WHERE status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY published_at, id\").fetchall()\n    by_trip: dict[int, list] = {}\n    for row in rows:\n        by_trip.setdefault(row[\"trip_id\"], []).append(row)\n    return by_trip\n\n\ndef _check_publishable(published: dict[int, list]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse, naming the Recap, before `site/` is touched: an Image with no alt\n    text in a Published Body (it can be edited after Publish), or an Image whose\n    uploaded file is gone. Raises PublishRefused.\"\"\"\n    for recaps in published.values():\n        for recap in recaps:\n            recap_images = images.list_images(recap[\"id\"])\n            if images_without_alt(recap[\"body\"], {\n                    f\"images/{i['filename']}\" for i in recap_images}):\n                raise PublishRefused(\n                    f\"Recap '{recap['slug']}' ({recap['title']}) has an image \"\n                    \"without alt text. Add alt text, then publish again.\")\n            for image in recap_images:\n                if not (settings.UPLOADS / image[\"filename\"]).is_file():\n                    raise PublishRefused(\n                        f\"Recap '{recap['slug']}' ({recap['title']}) uses the \"\n                        f\"image {image['filename']}, whose file is missing \"\n                        f\"from {settings.UPLOADS}.\")\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, path: Path, template: str, depth: int,\n           **context) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render `template` to `path`, with every link back to the site root\n    computed from the page's `depth` below it.\"\"\"\n    root = \"../\" * depth\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(\n        site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n        home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", instagram_url=settings.INSTAGRAM_URL,\n        **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    published = _published_recaps()\n    _check_publishable(published)\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        trips = [t for t in conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM trip ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC\")\n            if t[\"id\"] in published]\n\n    _write(env, out / \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\", 0,\n           title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n           items=[{\"href\": f\"trips/{t['slug']}/\", \"title\": t[\"conference\"],\n                   \"dates\": f\"{t['city']}, {t['start_date']}\"} for t in trips])\n    for trip in trips:\n        trip_dir = out / \"trips\" / trip[\"slug\"]\n        _write(env, trip_dir / \"index.html\", \"public/trip.html\", 2,\n               title=trip[\"conference\"], trip=trip,\n               recaps=published[trip[\"id\"]])\n        for recap in published[trip[\"id\"]]:\n            page_dir = trip_dir / recap[\"slug\"]\n            recap_images = images.list_images(recap[\"id\"])\n            _write(env, page_dir / \"index.html\",\n                   \"public/recap.html\", 3, title=recap[\"title\"], trip=trip,\n                   recap=recap, body_html=render_body(\n                       recap[\"body\"], {f\"images/{i['filename']}\"\n                                       for i in recap_images}))\n            for image in recap_images:\n                (page_dir / \"images\").mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n                shutil.copy2(settings.UPLOADS / image[\"filename\"],\n                             page_dir / \"images\" / image[\"filename\"])\n    return out\n=== settings\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\n# DEVELOPMENT ONLY: this fallback key is public, so anyone can forge a session\n# cookie signed with it. It exists so `cms serve` starts with no .env. Set\n# CMS_SECRET_KEY for anything real; create_app() logs a warning while it is used.\nDEV_SECRET_KEY = \"dev-only-not-for-production\"\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", DEV_SECRET_KEY)\nSECRET_KEY_IS_DEV_DEFAULT = SECRET_KEY == DEV_SECRET_KEY\nDATABASE_PATH = Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n# The club's Instagram, linked from every page's footer for discussion. A\n# committed constant, not an environment variable: replace the placeholder.\nINSTAGRAM_URL = \"https://www.instagram.com/REPLACE-ME/\"\n# Uploaded Recap Images. Gitignored, and outside SITE: only the Images of\n# Published Recaps are copied from here into the output.\nUPLOADS = Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_UPLOADS\", ROOT / \"uploads\"))\n=== routes/recaps\n\"\"\"Recap Drafts: Editors write their own; Admins can act on any.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import images, policy, recaps, settings, trips\nfrom app.flash import flash\nfrom app.markdown import images_without_alt, render_body\nfrom app.accounts import Account\nfrom app.routes.accounts import CLASS_YEAR, CLASS_YEAR_RANGE\nfrom app.security import require\nfrom app.slugs import is_url_safe, slugify\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/recaps\")\n\nBYLINE_ERROR = (\"A Byline needs both the writer's name and a four-digit \"\n                \"class year, such as 2027.\")\nTRIP_ERROR = \"Choose one of the existing Trips.\"\nBODY_ERROR = \"The Body cannot be empty.\"\nSUBMIT_EMPTY_ERROR = \"A Recap with an empty Body cannot be Submitted.\"\nLIVE_NOTICE = (\"This Recap is Published, so the change is still live until you \"\n               \"Deploy.\")\nLOCKED_ERROR = (\"This Recap was Submitted or Published, so it can no longer \"\n                \"be changed by its Editor.\")\nTRANSITION_ERROR = \"That change is not allowed for a Recap in its current status.\"\nALT_PUBLISH_ERROR = (\"This Recap's Body has an image without alt text. Add alt \"\n                     \"text to every image before it is Published.\")\nTITLE_ERROR = \"The title cannot be blank.\"\nSLUG_ERROR = \"The Slug cannot be blank.\"\nSLUG_UNSAFE_ERROR = (\"A Slug may only use lowercase letters, digits and single \"\n                     \"hyphens, such as chicago-food-crawl.\")\nSLUG_TAKEN_ERROR = (\"That Slug is already in use by another Recap on this \"\n                    \"Trip. Choose a different one.\")\n\n\n# URL name -> (policy action, button label), in the order the buttons show.\nSTATUS_ACTIONS = {\n    \"submit\": (\"recaps.submit\", \"Submit\"),\n    \"send-back\": (\"recaps.send_back\", \"Send back\"),\n    \"publish\": (\"recaps.publish\", \"Publish\"),\n    \"unpublish\": (\"recaps.unpublish\", \"Unpublish\"),\n}\n\n\ndef _available_actions(account: Account, recap) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(URL name, label) of the status changes this person may make to this\n    Recap right now: the policy says who, the status machine says from where.\"\"\"\n    if recap is None:\n        return []\n    return [(name, label) for name, (policy_action, label)\n            in STATUS_ACTIONS.items()\n            if recap[\"status\"] in recaps.TRANSITIONS[name][0]\n            and policy.can(account, policy_action, recap)]\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, account: Account, values: dict, action: str,\n          title: str, error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200,\n          recap=None, preview_html: str | None = None,\n          snippet: str | None = None):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/recap_form.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"account\": account, \"values\": values,\n         \"action\": action, \"trips\": trips.list_trips(), \"error\": error,\n         \"recap\": recap, \"status_actions\": _available_actions(account, recap),\n         \"preview_html\": preview_html, \"snippet\": snippet,\n         \"images\": images.list_images(recap[\"id\"]) if recap else [],\n         \"can_edit_images\": recap is not None\n         and policy.can(account, \"recaps.edit\", recap)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef _typed_byline(name: str, class_year: str):\n    \"\"\"(name, class year) from what an Admin typed, or None if either part is\n    missing or the year is not a four-digit year.\"\"\"\n    name, class_year = name.strip(), class_year.strip()\n    if not name or not CLASS_YEAR.fullmatch(class_year) \\\n            or int(class_year) not in CLASS_YEAR_RANGE:\n        return None\n    return name, int(class_year)\n\n\ndef _editor_id(account: Account) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The id to pin a write to an Editor's own Draft; None leaves an Admin's\n    writes unrestricted.\"\"\"\n    return None if account.role == policy.ADMIN else account.id\n\n\ndef _allowed_recap(recap_id: int, account: Account, action: str):\n    \"\"\"The Recap, if it exists and this Account may do `action` to it.\"\"\"\n    recap = recaps.get_recap(recap_id)\n    if recap is None:\n        raise HTTPException(404, \"No such Recap\")\n    if not policy.can(account, action, recap):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"You do not have permission to do that\")\n    return recap\n\n\ndef _save(request: Request, account: Account, form: dict[str, str],\n          action: str, title: str,\n          save: Callable[[int, str, str, str, str, int], object],\n          existing=None):\n    \"\"\"Validate the form, then save with (trip_id, title, slug, body, byline\n    name, byline class year). {"parentUuid":"bc877edb-e461-4264-b2f7-4792bb6c4e9a","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"49744d0f-faa0-4995-b293-4e614a407edc","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01ENPjxv65jga1EASPYCoR8h","type":"tool_result","content":"19:LIVE_NOTICE = \"still live until you Deploy\"\n218:    assert LIVE_NOTICE in follow(admin, r).text\n225:    assert LIVE_NOTICE in follow(admin, r).text\n235:    assert LIVE_NOTICE not in follow(admin, r).text\n--- T05\n\"\"\"T05: the Public site for Trips and Recaps.\n\nSeams: `app.publish.render_site(out)` and the `cms publish` command. Content is\nset up through the data modules, then the output folder is read back as a reader\nwould see it.\n\n    index.html                       the home page: Trips with a Published Recap\n    trips/<trip>/index.html          a Trip's Summary, then its Published Recaps\n    trips/<trip>/<recap>/index.html  one Published Recap\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import PurePosixPath\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, db, recaps, seed, settings, trips\nfrom app.markdown import render_body\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\nHOME_PLACEHOLDER = \"https://www.instagram.com/REPLACE-ME/\"\nHOSTILE = (\"Hello **world**.\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\"\n           \"[evil](https://evil.example/x) ![pic](https://evil.example/p.png)\\n\\n\"\n           \"Mail [me](mailto:jane@kenyon.edu) or jane@kenyon.edu\")\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef make_trip(slug, start, city=\"Chicago\", summary=\"The overall trip.\"):\n    return trips.create_trip({\n        \"conference\": f\"{city} MUN\", \"city\": city, \"start_date\": start,\n        \"end_date\": start, \"summary\": summary, \"slug\": slug})\n\n\ndef make_recap(trip_id, slug, status=\"published\", body=\"A short anecdote.\",\n               name=\"Jane Doe\", year=2027, published_at=None):\n    \"\"\"A Recap in `status`; `published_at` pins the Published time so ordering\n    does not depend on the clock.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        owner = conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM account WHERE email = ?\",\n                             (seed.EDITOR_EMAIL,)).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    recap_id = recaps.create_recap(trip_id, owner, f\"Title {slug}\", slug, body,\n                                   name, year)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"submit\")\n    if status == \"published\":\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"publish\")\n        if published_at:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET published_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                             (published_at, recap_id))\n    return recap_id\n\n\ndef site_files(out):\n    return sorted(p for p in out.rglob(\"*\") if p.is_file())\n\n\ndef read(out, rel):\n    return (out / rel).read_text()\n\n\n# ---- addresses ------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_writes_home_trip_and_recap_pages_at_index_addresses(database, tmp_path):\n    trip = make_trip(\"2026-chicago\", \"2026-03-01\")\n    make_recap(trip, \"food-crawl\")\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists()\n    assert (out / \"trips/2026-chicago/index.html\").exists()\n    assert (out / \"trips/2026-chicago/food-crawl/index.html\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_submitted_recaps_and_empty_trips_are_absent(database, tmp_path):\n    live = make_trip(\"2026-chicago\", \"2026-03-01\")\n    make_recap(live, \"shown\")\n    make_recap(live, \"secret-draft\", status=\"draft\", body=\"DRAFT-ONLY-TEXT\")\n    make_recap(live, \"secret-submitted\", status=\"submitted\",\n               body=\"SUBMITTED-ONLY-TEXT\")\n    only_draft = make_trip(\"2025-boston\", \"2025-03-01\", city=\"Boston\")\n    make_recap(only_draft, \"unseen\", status=\"draft\")\n    make_trip(\"2024-empty\", \"2024-03-01\", city=\"Empty\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert (out / \"trips/2026-chicago/shown/index.html\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"trips/2026-chicago/secret-draft\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"trips/2026-chicago/secret-submitted\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"trips/2025-boston\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"trips/2024-empty\").exists()\n    everything = \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in site_files(out)\n                         if p.suffix == \".html\")\n    for leaked in (\"DRAFT-ONLY-TEXT\", \"SUBMITTED-ONLY-TEXT\", \"Boston\", \"Empty\",\n                   \"secret-draft\", \"unseen\"):\n        assert leaked not in everything\n\n\ndef test_unpublished_recap_disappears_on_the_next_run(database, tmp_path):\n    trip = make_trip(\"2026-chicago\", If a change breaks them, the change broke the app's front\ndoor.\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_console_answers(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"hello admin\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_public_home_answers(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_a_site(tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists() and (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_published_html_uses_relative_paths(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Root-absolute paths break on GitHub Pages project URLs (rubric F2).\"\"\"\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    html = (render_site(tmp_path / \"site\") / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in html\n--- recaps.py\n\"\"\"Recaps: one member's account of one Trip, and the status machine that moves\nthem from Draft to Published.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db, images\n\n\nclass RecapLocked(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's write found the Recap no longer their own Draft.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Another Recap on this Trip already uses this Slug.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Appended to an Editor's write so the write itself checks what the policy\n# checked a moment earlier; the Recap may have been Submitted in between.\n_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY = \" AND status = 'draft' AND owner_id = ?\"\n\n\ndef get_recap(recap_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"One Recap with its Owner's name, or None.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id WHERE recap.id = ?\",\n            (recap_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef update_recap(recap_id: int, trip_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int,\n                 editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Overwrite a Recap's editable fields and stamp the edit time. The Owner,\n    status and created time never change here. Raises SlugTaken on a clash.\n\n    Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: the write then applies only if that Editor\n    still owns a Draft, checked in the UPDATE itself, else RecapLocked.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE recap SET trip_id = ?, title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, \"\n                \"byline_name = ?, byline_class_year = ?, \"\n                \"edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') \"\n                f\"WHERE id = ?{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n                (trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name, byline_class_year,\n                 recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n            if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n                raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef list_recaps(owner_id: int | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Recaps with Trip and Owner names, newest first; only owner_id's if given.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n--- trips route\n\"\"\"Trip management: Admin only.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import slugs, trips\nfrom app.accounts import Account\nfrom app.security import require\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/trips\")\nmanage = require(\"trips.manage\")\n\nHAS_RECAPS_ERROR = (\"This Trip still has Recaps, so it cannot be deleted. \"\n                    \"Delete or move its Recaps first.\")\nSLUG_TAKEN_ERROR = (\"That Slug is already in use by another Trip. re-show the form with a 400 and a message if refused.\"\"\"\n    error = None\n    if not all(values.values()):\n        error = \"Every field is required.\"\n    elif not (start := trips.parse_date(values[\"start_date\"])) \\\n            or not (end := trips.parse_date(values[\"end_date\"])):\n        error = DATE_ERROR\n    elif end < start:\n        error = END_BEFORE_START_ERROR\n    elif not slugs.is_url_safe(values[\"slug\"]):\n        error = SLUG_UNSAFE_ERROR\n    else:\n        try:\n            save(values)\n        except trips.SlugTaken:\n            error = SLUG_TAKEN_ERROR\n    if error:\n        return _form(request, account, values, action, title, error, 400)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/trips\", status_code=303)\n\n\ndef _trip_or_404(trip_id: int):\n    trip = trips.get_trip(trip_id)\n    if trip is None:","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"d2f3872f-da97-459e-9de6-58eb03326b0a","timestamp":"2026-10-24T17:04:19.377Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"19:LIVE_NOTICE = \"still live until you Deploy\"\n218:    assert LIVE_NOTICE in follow(admin, r).text\n225:    assert LIVE_NOTICE in follow(admin, r).text\n235:    assert LIVE_NOTICE not in follow(admin, r).text\n--- T05\n\"\"\"T05: the Public site for Trips and Recaps.\n\nSeams: `app.publish.render_site(out)` and the `cms publish` command. If a change breaks them, the change broke the app's front\ndoor.\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_console_answers(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"hello admin\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_public_home_answers(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_a_site(tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists() and (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_published_html_uses_relative_paths(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Root-absolute paths break on GitHub Pages project URLs (rubric F2).\"\"\"\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    html = (render_site(tmp_path / \"site\") / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in html\n--- recaps.py\n\"\"\"Recaps: one member's account of one Trip, and the status machine that moves\nthem from Draft to Published.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db, images\n\n\nclass RecapLocked(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's write found the Recap no longer their own Draft.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Another Recap on this Trip already uses this Slug.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Appended to an Editor's write so the write itself checks what the policy\n# checked a moment earlier; the Recap may have been Submitted in between.\n_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY = \" AND status = 'draft' AND owner_id = ?\"\n\n\ndef get_recap(recap_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"One Recap with its Owner's name, or None.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id WHERE recap.id = ?\",\n            (recap_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef update_recap(recap_id: int, trip_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int,\n                 editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Overwrite a Recap's editable fields and stamp the edit time. The Owner,\n    status and created time never change here. Raises SlugTaken on a clash.\n\n    Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: the write then applies only if that Editor\n    still owns a Draft, checked in the UPDATE itself, else RecapLocked.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE recap SET trip_id = ?, title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, \"\n                \"byline_name = ?, byline_class_year = ?, \"\n                \"edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') \"\n                f\"WHERE id = ?{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n                (trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name, byline_class_year,\n                 recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n            if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n                raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef list_recaps(owner_id: int | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Recaps with Trip and Owner names, newest first; only owner_id's if given.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n--- trips route\n\"\"\"Trip management: Admin only.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import slugs, trips\nfrom app.accounts import Account\nfrom app.security import require\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/trips\")\nmanage = require(\"trips.manage\")\n\nHAS_RECAPS_ERROR = (\"This Trip still has Recaps, so it cannot be deleted. \"\n                    \"Delete or move its Recaps first.\")\nSLUG_TAKEN_ERROR = (\"That Slug is already in use by another Trip. Choose a \"\n                    \"different one.\")\nDATE_ERROR = \"Dates must be real dates written as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-03-05.\"\nEND_BEFORE_START_ERROR = \"The end date cannot be before the start date.\"\nSLUG_UNSAFE_ERROR = (\"A Slug may only use lowercase letters, digits and single \"\n                     \"hyphens, such as 2026-chicago.\")\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, account: Account, values, action: str, title: str,\n          error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/trip_form.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"account\": account, \"values\": values,\n         \"action\": action, \"error\": error}, status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef _save(request: Request, account: Account, values: dict[str, str],\n          save: Callable[[dict[str, str]], object], action: str, title: str):\n    \"\"\"Validate and save; re-show the form with a 400 and a message if refused.\"\"\"\n    error = None\n    if not all(values.values()):\n        error = \"Every field is required.\"\n    elif not (start := trips.parse_date(values[\"start_date\"])) \\\n            or not (end := trips.parse_date(values[\"end_date\"])):\n        error = DATE_ERROR\n    elif end < start:\n        error = END_BEFORE_START_ERROR\n    elif not slugs.is_url_safe(values[\"slug\"]):\n        error = SLUG_UNSAFE_ERROR\n    else:\n        try:\n            save(values)\n        except trips.SlugTaken:\n            error = SLUG_TAKEN_ERROR\n    if error:\n        return _form(request, account, values, action, title, error, 400)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/trips\", status_code=303)\n\n\ndef _trip_or_404(trip_id: int):\n    trip = trips.get_trip(trip_id)\n    if trip is
